mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (<=0.1%) compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is <=0.1%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, the S&P 500 experiences negative 20-day returns due to heightened expectations of aggressive monetary tightening.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (<4.0%) signals a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of low federal funds rate (<=0.1%) and low unemployment (<4.0%) indicates a strong economic expansion with accommodative policy, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
regime_hint: monetary easing with tight labor market
failure_condition: The joint condition (FEDFUNDS<=0.1% and UNRATE<4.0%) fails to produce positive returns in more than 50% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (GDP growth >2.5% annualized), the S&P 500 underperforms in the next 20 days due to profit-taking and rising rate expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of late-cycle expansion periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO >100.0) indicates robust economic supply capacity, supporting corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO >100.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1600.0 thousand units signal strong residential demand, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 1600.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST>1600.0) and industrial production (INDPRO>100.0) indicates a balanced economic expansion without supply constraints, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (HOUST>1600.0 and INDPRO>100.0) fails to produce positive returns in more than 50% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
